Simple-path enumeration replaced with offset propagation: one number per edge, worklist over nodes, and a node holding two offsets is the conflict. The good-engineering parts worth your eyes:
- Verdict movement is zero by machine check — the sweep's refusal-reason diff (restated=0 added=0 removed=0 across all 196 compiled fixtures), plus all 5 historical bug classes in the replay gate
still caught.
- Equivalence is checked, never assumed: propagation agrees with enumeration exactly when every cycle weighs zero; that precondition is verified per component, and the one shape that fails it falls
back to a path the checker already refuses.
- The new count rail's sabotage receipt exposed why this survived so long: the old rail measured a chain (one route) and stayed green through the whole exponential era — cost rails have to measure
the axis that actually blows up.
- Free finding: the parse-phase compile-speed regression is not the clock checker (isolated by revert) — that hunt is still open, now with a narrower suspect list.
